messages:
Jamie (CSM): Quick async standup for NorthBridge Health — renewal in 12 days, trying to get ahead of adoption blockers. What I did / blockers / today:

Lucy (CS Ops): Did a full triage of the onboarding webhook errors from last night. Seeing repeated 502s from the webhook router for events with size > 48kb. Sample event_id: evt_9f3b2a.

Devon (Eng): thanks — can you paste the raw HTTP log for evt_9f3b2a? I want to check if it's timing out vs upstream returning 502. Also linking PR that might help: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/782 (small retry/backoff tweak).

Lucy (CS Ops): paste of the minimal failing request:
```
POST /v1/webhook/nbh HTTP/1.1
Host: webhook.redwood.internal
Content-Length: 51243
User-Agent: NBH-onboard/1.2.0

{...payload...}

Response: HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
X-Request-ID: req_aa331
```

Lucy (CS Ops): Also seeing this pattern only from NBH region eu-west-1. Other customers fine.

Miguel (SRE): @Devon I saw increased 499/502s off the router at ~03:10 UTC in eu-west-1. Can you check the backend pool health? I opened an incident stub: https://incidents/redwood/INC-2026-119 (opsbot created).

OpsBot: Incident INC-2026-119 created by Miguel (SRE) — high 502s from webhook-router in eu-west-1 affecting WebhookDelivery service. Incident status: investigating.

Devon (Eng): looking at the backend logs now. Early hypothesis: client payload size pushes the upstream timeout with our current 30s per-request limit on that worker type. I can try increasing the timeout on the webhook-worker group to 90s for a short window. Will need SRE approval for the config change.

Miguel (SRE): go ahead with a temporary bump to 90s and monitor. If we see CPU spike, rollback. I'll watch metrics and coordinate.

Jamie (CSM): Thanks — two asks from CS side: 1) Can we get the timeout bump + a targeted retry for large payloads before EOD? 2) I need a short note we can send to the customer explaining the workaround and ETA for permanent fix (we prefer <=48h).

Devon (Eng): will do the timeout bump now and push the retry tweak to the PR (782). ETA for hotfix deploy ~3h. Permanent fix (streaming/size-splitting) depends on backlog — estimate 2-3 sprints.

Priya (PM): I'll draft the customer note. Jamie, do you want me to join the renewal call tomorrow to reassure NBH about roadmaps?

Jamie (CSM): Yes please — if you can join the 10am CET sync that would help. I'll send invite once I have confirmation from the customer.

Lucy (CS Ops): after Devon's change I still see a few 502s but rate is down from ~12/min to ~1/min in eu-west-1. Looks promising.

Devon (Eng): rolled back the 90s bump to 60s after observing a small CPU increase on the worker; retry logic applied for payloads > 32kb with exponential backoff (up to 3 tries). Monitoring dashboards: link https://dashboards/redwood/webhook-delivery?region=eu-west-1

Miguel (SRE): metrics steady, error-rate trending down. Leaving incident open until +24h no regressions.

Jamie (CSM): Perfect — I'll message NBH with the interim update: timeout/retry applied, ETA for hotfix ~3h, permanent plan in roadmap. Also asking for permission to extend renewal conversation if they want a deeper tech review.

Devon (Eng): one remaining item: we saw a quota spike for NBH during onboarding — Jamie can you confirm whether they requested an increased concurrency for ingest? If so, CS can approve a temporary bump on account-level quotas.

Jamie (CSM): They asked for a temporary higher ingest rate yesterday. I approved +2x for 48h — I'll confirm the timing and post the account id here.

Lucy (CS Ops): TL;DR: blocker mitigated, monitoring, customer update draft incoming from Priya/Jamie, incident open until clear. :thumbsup:

Jamie (CSM): Thanks all — I'll follow up with a short summary for the renewal thread and tag this incident. If anyone wants to jump on a quick sync, ping me. :eyes:
